summary: Bomberman entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Bomberman
entries.definitive_edition: Original 1983 computer/MSX route, with Famicom/NES labeled separately if used

emulation.emulator: MSX/computer emulator or NES emulator for console comparison
emulation.notes: Document exact platform because versions differ.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original computer hardware/version or accurate emulation with platform recorded

primary.version: Original Bomber Man/Bomberman computer release, with Famicom/NES route documented separately
primary.why: The 1983 Bomberman/Bomber Man computer releases are the origin point, while the 1985 Famicom/NES version is the widely known home-console route that shaped the series. The archive should label whether it is preserving the original computer game or the later console interpretation.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original computer/MSX route through original hardware or accurate emulation for the 1983 target. Record platform/version, region/name variant, emulator/hardware, controls, level, enemy set, and whether Famicom/NES or later multiplayer Bomberman entries were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for culturally familiar console comparison.
secondary.why: It is important but later than the 1983 computer origin.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with later multiplayer Bomberman entries or Super Bomberman R.
